programs.title: Incas: The Rise and Fall
programs.desc: The origins of the emergence of an advanced ancient civilization in South America.According to Inca mythology, the legendary founder of the Inca dynasty and the city of Cuzco is Manco Capac.An equally important figure was Pachacutec, one of the most distinguished rulers.It was during his reign that Machu Picchu was created.Thanks to conquests, reforms, revolutionizing architecture and infrastructure development, he transformed his kingdom into a powerful empire.He imposed a solar cult, establishing a sun festival.To maintain his power, he did not hesitate to perform human sacrifices.
